title: Bulk Unit Update
text:
Bulk Unit Update 
 Help > Transaction > Bulk Transactions" />
 Bulk Unit 
 Update 
 Bulk Unit Update refers to the process wherein a user can update details 
 of multiple units within a property management system simultaneously. 
 This can include elements such as Unit Number, Sub-unit Type, Floor, 
 Possession Date, Operational Status, and Facing Status for 
 a group of units within a single action. 
 What is the Need for Bulk Unit Update? 
 Bulk Unit Update is especially useful for developers who oversee multiple 
 units within a complex or development. Instead of manually updating each 
 unit’s information individually, they can make changes to several units 
 at once, saving time and reducing the risk of errors. 
 Use Case 
 Let’s take an example where a developer 
 oversees a condominium complex with hundreds of individual units. They 
 need to update the possession date for all units based on the hierarchy. 
 Using the Bulk Unit Update feature, the property managers can select 
 all the units and adjust the possession date in a single operation, rather 
 than editing each unit one by one. This not only saves them a significant 
 amount of time but also ensures consistency and accuracy across all the 
 affected units. 
 Users will 
 be able to make Unit Update in Bulk through this interface. 
 Criteria 
 Selection 
 Criteria 
 Business 
 Unit : Select the required Business Unit 
 Hierarchy : 
 Select the Hierarchy Level 
 Unit 
 Type : Select the Unit Type 
 Sub 
 Unit Type : Select the Sub Unit Type 
 Unit : 
 Select the Unit 
 Click on 
 Next . 
 Output 
 Output 
 Details 
 Click on 
 the respective unit number. The 'Unit No Update' window will open. 
 Update the 
 Unit No, Sub Unit Type, Floor, Possession Date as per requirement. Fill 
 the required data in Operational Status, Towards East, Towards West, Towards 
 North and Towards South and click on Submit. 
 Click on 
 Update button to update the changes. 
 Log 
 Once user 
 clicks on the Update button the data will be updated and success messages 
 will be shown under 'Log'.

 Import 
 Excel 
 Import facility given against Bulk Unit Update menu. 
 Step

 Step

 Gamut Infosystems Limited

title: Bulk Unit Hold/Unhold
text:
Bulk Unit Hold/Unhold 
 Help > Transaction > Bulk Transactions" />
 Bulk 
 Unit Hold/Unhold 
 Bulk Unit Hold/Unhold is a feature that allows developers 
 or property managers to simultaneously hold or release multiple units 
 within a property based on their availability. This feature streamlines 
 the process of managing units that are in high demand or undergoing specific 
 conditions that require temporary hold. 
 What is the Benefit of Bulk Unit Hold/Unhold? 
 By allowing developers to bulk hold 
 or unhold units, the process becomes more efficient, and timesaving compared 
 to individually managing each unit’s status. 
 Developers can quickly respond to changing 
 internal requirements by holding or releasing multiple units at once. 
 It helps in ensuring that units are 
 allocated fairly based on availability, making the process transparent 
 and enhancing customer satisfaction. 
 Use Case 
 In a real estate development project 
 with multiple units available for sale, the marketing team launches a 
 special promotion offering a discount on a certain number of units for 
 a limited time. The developer uses the bulk unit hold feature to temporarily 
 reserve these units, ensuring that they are not sold out before the promotion 
 period ends. Once the promotion is over, the developer can easily unhold 
 these units, making them available for sale again. 
 Steps to Perform Bulk Unit Hold/Unhold 
 1. 1. 
 Navigate to Sales and Customer 
 Care> Bulk Transactions> Bulk Unit Hold/Unhold. The following 
 screen will be visible. 
 2. 2. 
 There are two options available under 
 the Action field: Hold and Unhold. Choose the one which is needed 
 for the specific unit. Fill in the details such as Business Unit, AsOn, 
 and Hierarchy. Click on Next once done. The following screen 
 will be visible. 
 3. 3. 
 Choose the Unit which has to 
 be set as Hold/Unhold. Click on Save and the entry will 
 be saved. 
 Now, navigate to Sales and Customer 
 Care> Report> Unit Status> Available 
 Unit . The required 
 reports are available there. 
 © 
 Gamut Infosystems Limited

title: Bulk Stamp Duty Generation
text:
Bulk Stamp Duty Generation 
 Help > Transaction > Bulk Transactions" />
 Bulk Stamp 
 Duty Generation 
 Users 
 will be able to generate stamp duty charges for booking(s) in bulk and 
 it will be auto-tagged in the “Offer of Possession” entry. 
 Note: 
 To generate a stamp duty charge for a Booking, the “Offer of Possession” 
 entry is mandatory, i.e. without having an Offer of Possession entry against 
 the respective booking user cannot process the Bulk Stamp Duty Generation. 
 The 
 rate(s) for stamp duty calculation (for Male/Female/Company as the applicant(s)) 
 and revenue head(s) on which the system will calculate stamp duty can 
 be set up from the backend. The client needs to provide the list of revenue 
 head(s) for which stamp duty will be calculated. 
 Select Business 
 Unit, Financial Year, Document Type, Document Date & Hierarchy (optional) 
 and click on next. 
 On the output 
 screen select the Booking(s) for which stamp duty is to be calculated 
 and click on Generate. 
 The system 
 will ask for confirmation, re-check the selected records and click on 
 Yes. 
 On the successful 
 generation of Stamp Duty charge, the system will show a confirmation message 
 on the Log screen. 
 To check 
 the generated stamp duty, go to the “Booking > Offer of Possession” 
 menu and open the transaction for which the Stamp Duty charge is generated.

title: Status Matrix
text:
Status Matrix 
 Queries" />
 Status 
 Matrix 
 Status matrix query gives report 
 of unit (Inventory) details after selection of business unit and tower. 
 This report is based on Business Unit and Tower selection. 
 Report criteria 
 There are two mandatory selections as follows 
 Business Unit 
 Tower: users will be able to view the 
 Status Matrix by selecting all Tower 
 Unit 
 Type : It will be populated 
 from master unit type. At a time single unit type can be selected. If 
 kept blank then all unit type data will be populated. 
 Unit 
 Status : Selection options 
 are Available/Booked/Blocked/Hold and All. As per selection data will be populated. 
 Floor : Selection options are All and floor. 
 As per selection data will be populated. 
 Typology : 
 Selection options are All and Typology. As per selection data will be populated. 
 Data will 
 populate Floor wise 
 Colour 
 legends will show the status of unit along with number of Unit 
 Booked 
 unit shows the Booking Number and Area of unit along with Unit type 
 Available unit shows 
 the Unit type and area of unit 
 If click on 
 available unit option it will show for unit Block 
 or Hold 
 If 
 check on Block option it will populate further to give information further 
 Customer 
 Name : Name of customer to be mentioned 
 Blocked 
 by : Name of the person who has blocked the unit 
 Blocker 
 Contact No. : Contact No. of person who has blocked 
 Blocked 
 upto : upto which period this unit will be blocked 
 Remarks 
 :Remarks is not mandatory but can give 
 for better understanding 
 After provided all the related information click 
 on save button 
 For 
 Hold only checked the Hold 
 button 
 Selected Unit will be hold.

title: Customer Outstanding
text:
Customer Outstanding 
 Queries" />
 Customer 
 Outstanding 
 Customer outstanding is a report where it will show 
 the receivable amount of customer based on Invoice generated. 
 User can take this report from Query as well as 
 from Report menu option. 
 Report criteria 
 Enterprise 
 Group of Companies 
 Company 
 Business Unit 
 Segment 
 Zone 
 User is required to select desired criteria – Enterprise/Group 
 of Companies/Company/Business Unit/ Segment/ Zone 
 User is required to select desired date to get the 
 reports on selected date 
 This 
 report can be exported to excel by clicking on Export to Excel button 
 Parent Account Head : if 
 Parent Account Head not chosen then all data will be populated. If parent 
 account head is selected then it will populate the data related to the 
 selected parent account only. 
 Option: There 
 are two options available 
 Default 
 Company wise 
 Default 
 – Account head wise data will be populated 
 Company wise 
 – After clicking on any Account Head, company wise data will be populated 
 If user clicks on any Account Head then it will 
 drill down to next level and details of selected Account Head will be 
 populated 
 This report can be exported to excel by clicking 
 on button 
 Segment and Zone 
 To enable Segment and Zone go to Administration 
 > Company > Business Unit (BU) 
 Step1 : Tag 
 the Business Units with respective Segment and Zone 
 Step2 : Go 
 to Queries > Customer Outstanding 
 Step3 : Select 
 the option as Segment or Zone 
 Step4 : Select 
 the respective Segment or Zone name 
 Step5 : Select 
 Parent Account Head as “Customer (Memorandum)” 
 Step6 : Click 
 on Refresh 
 Now check that system is displaying the Customer 
 Outstanding data based on the Segment or Zone selected. User can export 
 the same data to Excel format as well. 
 © 
 Gamut Infosystems Limited

 Applicant

 mode of receipt entry will be shown as per the payment mode selected in

 system

 Notes

 Sample Applicant ledger

 if Booking is in provisional mode, then system will print only the Application 
 details in Applicant ledger. 
 Now system will print only those details which 
 are related to the Application entry in Applicant Ledger of any Provisional 
 Booking. 
 Step1 : 
 Select one “Provisional” booking number 
 Step2 : 
 Click on Print and then select a print format and print he applicant ledger 
 Step3 : 
 Now check that system is only printing that information which are linked 
 only with the application entry

title: Brokerage
text:
Brokerage 
 Tutorial" />
 Brokerage 
 Brokers 
 may be involved during sale of Property to customer. Brokerage will be 
 involved in this process and Broker will raise Brokerage bill after defined 
 amount of money has been received from the customer against the 
 flats where the broker is involved during sale. 
 Process of implementation of Brokerage 
 calculation and Brokerage Bill is as follows: 
 1. Creation of Broker Group 
 (Path: 
 Sales and Customer Care > 
 Setup > 
 Brokerage > 
 Brokerage Group) 
 Broker works for the property owners in the real 
 estate transactions. Brokers can be grouped based on their type of work 
 or area of work. 
 Code: 
 Enter Broker Group Code 
 Description: Enter Group description 
 2. Broker Creation 
 (Path: 
 Sales and Customer Care > 
 Setup > 
 Brokerage > 
 Broker) 
 Broker acts as intermediate between sellers and 
 buyers of real estate units. Against selling a house, Broker gets a small 
 part of money (brokerage) based on the preferred agreement. All the details 
 pertaining to a broker can be entered here. 
 Code: Enter the Code of the 
 broker 
 Name: 
 Enter the Name of the Broker 
 Group: 
 Select the Group of the Broker 
 Contact 
 Person: Enter the Contact person Name 
 Address 
 Line1: 
 Enter the 1 st Line of the address 
 Line2: 
 Enter the 2 nd Line of the address 
 Country: 
 Enter the Country of the Broker 
 State: 
 Enter the State 
 City: 
 Enter the City 
 Postal 
 Code/ZIP: Enter the Postal Code 
 Communication 
 Mobile: 
 Enter the communication Mobile No 
 Phone: 
 Enter the Communication Phone No 
 Email: 
 Enter Communication Email Id 
 3. Brokerage Template 
 (Path: 
 Sales and Customer Care > 
 Setup > 
 Brokerage > 
 Brokerage Template) 
 To define brokerage calculation Process, user ha 
 to define the same through Brokerage Template. In real estate scenario 
 brokerage fees are usually computed on Flat Basis or Percentage basis. 
 Code: 
 Enter Template Code 
 Description: 
 Enter Template Description 
 Payout 
 Type: Select Payout Type from Dropdown (in this case it will be Brokerage) 
 Basis: 
 Select Basis from Dropdown (in this case it will be Flat) 
 For 
 Percentage Base 
 Calculation 
 Basis: Select Calculation Basis from Dropdown (in this case it will 
 be Percentage Based) 
 Calculation 
 Formula: From Formula definition page select Revenue heads and operands 
 (+,-,* etc.) based on which percentage will be calculated 
 Click Add New 
 Row 
 Put the rate of % which will be calculated on chargeable 
 Amount defined in Formula and Effective Upto date 
 For more Effective date wise % repeat adding row 
 For 
 Area Base 
 Calculation 
 Basis: Select Calculation Basis from Dropdown (in this case it will 
 be Area Based) 
 Calculation 
 Formula: From Formula definition page select Revenue heads and operands 
 (+,-,* etc.) based on which percentage will be calculated 
 Click Add New 
 Row 
 Put the rate of amount which will be multiplied 
 by chargeable area defined in Formula and Effective upto date 
 For more Effective date wise Amount repeat adding 
 row 
 For 
 Lumpsum/Fixed 
 Calculation 
 Basis: Select Calculation Basis from Dropdown (in this case it will 
 be Lumpsum/Fixed) 
 Click Add New 
 Row 
 Put the amount which will be effective on each Booking 
 and Effective upto date 
 For more Effective date wise Amount repeat adding 
 row 
 4 . Brokerage Release 
 (Path: 
 Sales and Customer Care è 
 Setup è 
 Brokerage è 
 Brokerage Release) 
 Installment payment percentage of the brokerage 
 is to be released based on collection received from customer or payment 
 plan wise are to be defined here. In most of the cases calculation are 
 based on the collection received 
 Release 
 Type: Select Release Type as Collection wise 
 Code: 
 Enter brokerage release Code 
 Description: 
 Enter brokerage release Description 
 Payout 
 Type: Select Payout Type (in this case it will be Brokerage) 
 Now based on the collection percentage wise release 
 do the following steps: 
 i. Click 
 Add New Row 
 ii. Put 
 Collection Percentage From 
 iii. Put 
 Collection Percentage To 
 iv. Put 
 Release Percent 
 Keep on repeat 
 the process until the Total of Release Percent become 100% 
 5 . Brokerage Template Tagging 
 (Path: 
 Sales and Customer Care > 
 Setup > 
 Brokerage > 
 Brokerage Template Tagging) 
 Broker wise template has to be tagged here. Each 
 Broker wise Agreement No, Agreement Date, Brokerage Template and Brokerage 
 Release has to be tagged here. 
 MOU NO: 
 Enter the MOU No 
 MOU Date: 
 Enter the MOU Date 
 Broker: 
 Select the respective Broker 
 Brokerage 
 Template: Select respective Brokerage template 
 Brokerage 
 Release: Select respective Brokerage Release Setup 
 6 . Tagging Broker in Booking 
 (Path: 
 Sales and Customer Care > 
 Booking > 
 Booking) 
 At the time of Booking, In Broker 
 Info tab, select Broker Type as Individual, then click on Add New 
 Row and select The Broker. System 
 will Calculate Brokerage Amount. 
 7 . Broker Invoice 
 (Path: 
 Sales and Customer Care > 
 Brokerage > 
 Broker Invoice) 
 After 
 proper payment receipt from Customer, Broker raised their Invoice. The 
 steps are as follows: 
 i. Select 
 Business Unit 
 ii. Select 
 Document Type 
 iii. Select 
 Document Date 
 iv. Select 
 Broker 
 v. Put 
 Invoice No given by Broker 
 vi. Put 
 Invoice date 
 vii. Put 
 Due Date 
 viii. Now 
 all relevant Booking with Brokerage Eligible Amount, and This release 
 will show. 
 ix. Select 
 relevant Booking against which Bill will be raised. 
 x. System 
 will show the Total Amount. 
 xi. Do 
 the necessary changes in Billing Term 
 xii. Save 
 the Broker Invoice

title: Auto e-mail facility against Unit Blocking
text:
Auto e-mail facility against Unit Blocking 
 Tutorial" />
 Auto e-mail 
 facility against Unit Blocking 
 Now user 
 will be able to send auto email to users email id against the Unit Block 
 entry. 
 Step 1: Go 
 to Administration 
 > Communicator > Email Template and create an email template 
 against the Entry Type-Block Unit 
 Step 2: Go 
 to Administration 
 > Communicator > Communication Rule and create a communication 
 rule against the Entry Type - Block Unit 
 Step 3: Go 
 to Sales Force Automation 
 > Setup > Sales Team > Sales Person and create a sales person 
 master by tagging the user name. 
 Step 4: Go 
 to Sales 
 and Customer Care > Pricing > Block Unit 
 Step 5: Select 
 Business Unit, Fiscal Year, Document Type, Document Date, Unit No, enter 
 Blocked By, select Blocked Upto Date, enter Blocker Contact Number, Customer 
 Name, etc. 
 Step 6: Click 
 on Submit to save the entry. 
 Step 7: Now 
 check the users email inbox where that user can see the auto email received 
 against the Block Unit entry. 
 Note: The auto email for Block Unit will 
 be sent to the user id’s email 1 set in User id who is making the block 
 unit entry and to get the same Sales Person master should be created by 
 tagging the User id under Sales 
 Force Automation > Setup > Sales Team > Sales Person 
 © 
 Gamut Infosystems Limited

title: Lower GST or BOC control through Document Classification
text:
Lower GST or BOC control through Document Classification 
 Tutorial" />
 Lower 
 GST or BOC control through Document 
 Classification 
 In 
 Sales and Customer Care module, Lower GST is now applicable on the affordable 
 Unit(s), where below rate of GST are applicable on UNIT Charges and Vehicle 
 Parking. 
 Any 
 Booking after the receiving the Occupancy certificate or Completion certificate, 
 No GST will be applicable on UNIT Charges and Vehicle Parking and other 
 Revenue Heads (if applicable). 
 In 
 Farvision , with the same 
 HSN code, normal GST or Lower GST or No GST applicability can be imposed 
 through Document Classification. 
 Process 
 of implementation of Document 
 Classification is as follows: 
 1. Creation of Document Classification 
 entry through Administration Module: 
 Path: 
 Administration > 
 Setup 
 > Document Classification > Document Classification 
Enter Code and Description 
 of the Document Classification wants to create. 
 Examples : 
 for Lower GST, Code = LGST 
 and Description = Lower GST 
 for CC, Code = CC 
 and Description = Completion 
 Certificate 
 2 . Tagging 
 of Document Classification with TAX: 
 Path: Finance 
 > 
 Setup 
 > 
 Filter 
 > 
 Classification 
 Wise Tax Tagging 
 For Lower 
 GST 5% 
 For Completion 
 Certificate 
 Select 
 Document Classification created in Administration Menu. Put Rate 
 (for Lower GST it will be 7.5% so that after 1/3 abatement it will consider 
 as 5% and for Completion Certificate rate will be 0 and Type will be Exempted 
 so that No GST will be calculated). Put the Effective From date and Effective 
 To date so that in between period this rate will be applicable for the 
 mentioned Document Classification. 
 3 . After Successfully creation of Document 
 Classification users need to tag that document classification with Revenue 
 Head. 
 For tagging of the 
 same please go to Material > Setup > Item Master 
 and find the item name with the name of revenue head. For example, Revenue 
 Head Name is “Unit Cost”. Users need to search 
 item with the name of Unit cost in item master (Item master created automatically). 
 Editing in Item Master 
 Click on HSN tagging 
 and then tag the HSN with Classification. In case of Multiple classification 
 please add same HSN Multiple times with different document classifications. 
 4 . Effect of Document Classification 
 in New BOOKING Entry: 
 Path: 
 Sales 
 and Customer Care > 
 Booking 
 > 
 Booking 
 At the time of 
 booking entry, from the Other 
 Charges tab, click on any row where GST should be calculated based 
 on Document Classification (Lower GST or Completion Certificate). 
 System will open 
 the GST Calculation page. Select the proper Document Classification in 
 the Classification box. System will calculate the GST as per the Rate 
 defined earlier. 
 Example: LOWER GST classification 
 is selected on UNIT Charges, GST will be calculated based on the Rate 
 mentioned in the Document selected (e.g. For Lower GST system will calculate 
 2.5% CGST and 2.5% SGST). This process has to be replicated in all rows 
 where Tax Rate to be calculated based on Document Classification. 
 Likewise, if Completion 
 Certificate is received, then in the new Booking entry, in the Other Info 
 Tab, in all row(s) where zero rate Tax to be calculated, Document Classification 
 to be selected as Completion 
 Certificate. System will calculate Amount without any GST. 
 5 . Effect of Document Classification 
 in Existing BOOKING Entry: 
 To implement a 
 new Document Classification in an existing Booking the following process 
 has to be followed. 
 a. After 
 successful creation of Tagging of Document Classification with Revenue 
 Heads, a process is required to Tag those Document Classification(s) with 
 the required Revenue Heads. 
 b. This 
 is a manual process, please mention the Booking Number wise Document 
 Classification with applicable Revenue Heads to GAMUT Support 
 desk to do the necessary tagging. 
 c. Do 
 the Booking Amendment entry of the Booking No (with Document type Booking 
 Amendment) to get the proper effect of GST in the Booking.

title: B2B Customer’s Transaction which is registered other than the Stats of the Business Unit’s State
text:
B2B Customer’s Transaction which is registered other than the Stats of the Business Unit’s State 
 Tutorial" />
 B2B Customer’s 
 Transaction which is registered other than the Stats of the Business Unit’s 
 State 
 Now 
 system will allow to make Application, Booking, Invoice, Money Receipt, 
 Credit Note, Receipt Reversal, On Account Adjustment, Payment to Customer 
 entry against the GST Registered customer who is registered in a State 
 which is other than the Business Unit’s State. 
 For 
 example, the Business Unit is registered in Maharashtra and the Customer 
 is Registered in West Bengal, so now these types of customer related transactions 
 also now allowed in Sales and Customer Care module. 
 Step 1 : Go to Booking 
 > Application Details 
 Step 2 : Make an application entry 
 with a GST registered customer whose GST registration state is other than 
 your Business Unit’s State. 
 Step 3 : Now make Advance Money Receipt 
 against Application, Booking, Advance Money Receipt against Booking, Invoice, 
 Credit Note, Receipt Reversal, On Account Adjustment, Payment to Customer 
 entry against this same customer and check that system is now allowing 
 the same.

title: Payment Link Generation process against CRM Invoice
text:
Payment Link Generation process against CRM Invoice 
 Tutorial" />
 Payment 
 Link Generation process against CRM Invoice 
 Users will 
 be able to generate Payment Link against the CRM Invoices and will be 
 able to send the same to customer for online payment against that invoice. 
 After successful payment system will automatically generate the Money 
 Receipt. 
 Step 
 1 : Go to Finance > Setup > E-Banking > E-Banking 
 Setup 
 Step 
 2 : Enter Code, Description, select Gate Type as “Inward Remittance 
 (Payment Link), select Bank as “XXX PAYMENT LINK” 
 Step 
 3 : Enter the Merchant Id, Key Id, Key Secret, Locale, Link Expiry 
 Days, Min. Partial Amount Percentage. 
 Step 
 4 : Go to the “Business Unit Setup” tab. 
 Step 
 5 : Select the Business Unit for which user want to make the payment 
 link generation setup, Select Bank, Suspense Bank, Select Application 
 as “Sales and Customer Care”, Receipt Entry Type as “MR(RE), Select respective 
 Receipt Document Type, Select Contra Entry Type as “Deposit/Withdrawal”, 
 Select respective Contra Document Type, Select Payment Entry Type as “Receipt/Payment”, 
 Select respective Payment Document Type. 
 Step 
 6 : Click on Save button 
 Step 
 7 : Click on Submit to save the e-banking setup 
 Step 
 8 : Go to Invoicing > Invoice 
 Step 
 9 : Make an Invoice entry 
 Step 
 10 : Go to payment Link > Payment Link Creation 
 Step 
 11 : Select the respective Business Unit name under which user has 
 made the invoice entry 
 Step 
 12 : User can see all the outstanding invoices pending for Payment 
 Link Generation 
 Step 
 13 : Search and select the newly created invoice number 
 Step 
 14 : Click on Process to generate the payment link for this invoice. 
 Please note user may generate the payment link against multiple invoices 
 at a time also. 
 Step 
 15 : Once the process is completed, system will show the payment 
 link creation status here. 
 Step 
 16 : Once the payment link is generated the customer will be intimated 
 through an auto email and SMS along with the Payment URL. 
 Step 
 17 : User may send an email from the Invoice menu advance search 
 email option against the respective invoice number. Here 
 the customer will get invoice PDF copy along with the Payment Link URL 
 and QR Code in the email attachment . 
 Step 
 18 : Click on the Payment Link URL or scan the QR code to make an 
 online payment. 
 After clicking 
 the 'Payment Link' the following window will open. 
 Click on 
 'PROCEED' to continue. 
 Select payment 
 mode and click on 'Pay Now'. 
 Step 
 19 : Once the online Payment Process completes successfully, Farvision 
 will generate the Money Receipt automatically against that Online payment 
 receipt through the payment link. 
 Step 
 20 : After sometime go to Receipt menu and check that the desired 
 Receipt has been auto generated against the respective invoice.

title: 26AS Import and Auto Money Receipt JV entry Generation
text:
26AS Import and Auto Money Receipt JV entry Generation 
 Tutorial" />
 26AS Import 
 and Auto Money Receipt JV entry Generation 
 1. 26AS 
 Import 
 2. TDS 
 Reconciliation in Sales and Customer Care module before generation of 
 auto Money Receipt JV entry against 26AS data 
 3. Auto 
 Generation of Money Receipt JV entry against the 26AS imported Data 
 4. TDS 
 Reconciliation in Sales and Customer Care module after generation of auto 
 Money Receipt JV entry against 26AS data 
 1. 26AS Import 
 Form 26AS 
 is a consolidated annual tax statement that includes information on tax 
 deducted/collected at source, advance tax, self-assessment that is available 
 on the Income Tax website against a taxpayer's Permanent Account Number 
 (PAN) 
 Currently 
 26AS CSV or TXT file can be imported which is downloaded from NSDL website. 
 Step 1: Go to Financial module's home page 
 Step 2: Select 
 the Company for which 26AS form will be uploaded 
 Step 3: Go 
 to Taxation>> 26AS 
 Import 
 Step 4: Upload 
 the file in the above-mentioned window 
 Step 5: Now 
 click on the yellow highlighted area and click Import option 
 2. TDS Reconciliation in Sales and Customer Care 
 module before generation of auto Money Receipt JV entry against 26AS data 
 After completion 
 of the 26AS Import, please follow the below mention steps to get the list 
 of CRM customers for which you have imported the 26AS data. 
 Step 1: Go 
 to Sales and Customer Care module’s home page 
 Step 2: Go 
 to Reports>>TDS Report>>TDS Reconciliation 
 Step 3: Select 
 the Company for which 26AS data has been imported in Finance module. 
 Step 4: Select 
 the date range (From Date and To date) 
 Step 5: Click 
 on the Excel option to Download the report. 
 Step 6: Here 
 you can see the 26AS amount which was imported through 26AS Import under 
 Finance module 
 3. Auto Generation of Money Receipt JV entry against 
 the 26AS imported Data 
 Now to generate 
 the Money Receipt JV entry against the 26AS imported data please follow 
 the below mentioned steps: 
 Step 1: Go 
 to Sales and Customer Care module’s home page 
 Step 2: Go 
 to Collection>>TDS Import Money Receipt 
 Step 3: Select 
 the respective Business Unit, Financial Year, Document Type, Document 
 Date 
 Step 4: Select 
 the respective TDS Account Head (i.e. TDS (Immovable Property-194[IA]) 
 Received), this account head will be Debited after generation of the auto 
 money receipt JV entry 
 Step 5: Click 
 on Refresh, once you click on the Refresh button system will show all 
 the Customers Name for the selected Business Unit whose data was imported 
 though 26AS Import under Finance module 
 Step 6: Here 
 you can see the Customer Name, Booking No, Financial Year, PAN, Challan 
 No., Challan Date, Amount 
 Step 7: Select 
 the respective Customer names or select all customers 
 Step 8: Click 
 on Submit 
 Step 9: Wait 
 for some time to complete the Money Receipt JV entry generation, once 
 the Money Receipt entries generated successfully, the system will remove 
 those customers names from this Money Receipt generation window 
 Step 10: 
 Go to Collection>> Receipt >>Advance 
 Search 
 Step 11: 
 Search for the Customers whose auto Money Receipt JV entry for TDS 
 generated automatically 
 Step 12: 
 Check the auto generated Money Receipt JV entry 
 4. TDS Reconciliation in Sales and Customer Care 
 module after generation of auto Money Receipt JV entry against 26AS data 
 After completion 
 of the auto money receipt JV entry against the 26AS Imported data, please 
 follow the below mention steps to get the TDS reconciliation report for 
 26AS Amount VS TDS Received. 
 Step 1: Go 
 to Sales and Customer Care module’s home page 
 Step 2: Go 
 to Reports>>TDS Report>>TDS Reconciliation 
 Step 3: Select 
 the Company for which 26AS data has been imported in Finance module. 
 Step 4: Select 
 the date range (From Date and To date) 
 Step 5: Click 
 on the Excel option to Download the report 
 Step 6: Now 
 here you can see the 26AS amount and the TDS Received Amount 
 © 
 Gamut Infosystems Limited

title: Configuration
text:
Configuration 
 Mobile App > FV Approval" />
 Configuration Process 
 Mobile Configuration 
 Mobile configuration is required for each mobile app (both IOS and android) to enable push notifications. For details about Enterprise Name, server public IP and app credentials, please refer to the detailed help on Mobile Configuration . 
 Download Farvision Approval App from 
 1. Apple Apps Store (For IOS) 
 2. Android Store (For Android) 
 Please type FV Approval on Google Play Store/Apple Apps Store to find and download the mobile application or download from the following URLs 
 Download Links 
 For IOS 
 https://apps.apple.com/in/app/farvisionapprovalr2/id1435066074 
 For Android 
 https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.gamut.farvisionapprovalr2&hl=en_IN&gl=US 
 Cloud SetUp 
 Step1: Install and open FV Approval App. Press 'Configure Your App' to setup your account. 
 Step2: Press ‘Cloud SetUp’ if your Farvision application runs on Farvision Cloud server. Please contact your administrator to know your cloud server name. Choose your cloud server from “Cloud SetUp” option. 
 Step3: After account configuration, enter ‘User Name’ and ‘Password’ and press ‘Login’. 
 OR 
 Set Up 
 Step1: Install and open FV Approval App. Press 'Configure Your App' to setup your account. Press ‘Set Up’. 
 Step2 : Enter your Enterprise name and on premises server URL/IP. HTTPS is required to be checked if your server is SSL certified and you have entered domain name. If you have entered IP Address as server url then SSL is not required hence left this unchecked. 
 Step3: After account configuration, enter ‘User Name’ and ‘Password’ and press ‘Login’.

title: Frequently Asked Questions
text:
Frequently Asked Questions 
 Frequently 
 Asked Questions 
 Q. What 
 action should be taken to resolve the error encountered while saving a 
 booking? 
 Answer: Ensure 
 the HSN of the revenue head is selected in the 'Other charges' tab. 
 Q. What steps are necessary to address the inability 
 to save a booking ? 
 Answer: Set 
 up the respective Business Unit and Revenue Head. 
 Navigate 
 to Sales and Customer Care Module > 
 Setup > Revenue 
 Head/Scheme > Revenue Template , then 
 proceed with the booking entry. 
 Q. What could be a few of the 
 causes of an issue in booking ? 
 Answer: Causes 
 of the issue: a . Pricelist effective 
 date is greater than the booking date. b. 
 Payment 
 Plan Effective Upto date is not greater than booking date. 
 Q. How can 
 the issue of inability to add co-applicant name be addressed ? 
 Answer: Navigate 
 to Booking Amendment 
 > Name Change entry 
 to Add or Remove the co-applicant. 
 Q. How to 
 make area change after Unit Closure ? 
 Answer: 
 a. 
 Initiate Booking Amendment 
 ( Area Change ) - input 
 the area and make adjustments with a negative amount in the billed 
 schedule. 
 b. Follow up with a credit note for 
 the adjusted amount. 
 Q. How to 
 address 
 the issue while changing Co-Applicant to Applicant under Booking Amendment ? 
 Answer: Ensure 
 a two-level hierarchy 
 is present. 
 Q. How can 
 the issue of being unable to save a booking amendment with parking be 
 resolved ? 
 Answer: Add 
 only an independent unit 
 (main unit) from Booking 
 Amendment ; it should not be a child unit. 
 Q. How can the issue with updating 
 customer details be resolved if the provided email IDs are already associated 
 with other customer records ? 
 Answer: If 
 provided email ids were already used in other customer records, remove 
 them from others and then try to save with the new customer details. 
 Q. How 
 can the inability to reverse an invoice through a credit note be resolved ? 
 Answer: Pass 
 a Demand Reversal credit 
 note to amend the booking. 
 Q. What 
 could be the cause of Invoice LPF (late payment fees) scheduler not working 
 and how to we resolve this issue ? 
 Answer: Cause: 
 LPF setup done after the invoice date. The system didn't recognize 
 LPF due as of the invoice date. 
 Solution: Ensure LPF setup 
 is done before or on the invoice date. 
 For e.g. Invoice 
 Number- 01IN/00504/21-22, Invoice Date is 01-08-2021. No LPF due as 
 on 01-08-2021 will be shown, since the LPF setup was done for the 
 Business Unit on 10-08-2021 therefore as per system there was no LPF 
 as on 01-08-2021. 
 Q. What steps can be taken to address 
 issues when generating an invoice ? 
 Answer: 
 Cause: 
 Account head not tagged against revenue head. 
 Solution: 
 Check account tagging against all revenue heads used in the invoice. 
 Edit and tag account head debit side/credit side as needed. 
 Q. On 
 Account Adjustment: issue: How can 
 the issue with adjusting money receipts taken as advance against revenue 
 head 'ADMINISTRATIVE CHARGES' with other revenue head bills be resolved ? 
 Answer: 
 Money Receipt taken as advance against revenue 
 head 'ADMINISTRATIVE CHARGES', cannot be adjusted with other revenue 
 head bills (e.g., CANCELLATION CHARGES, Adhoc). 
 Q. How 
 can the issue of Ledger Balance and Money Receipt Balance mismatch be 
 resolved ? 
 Answer: 
 Perform 
 on-account adjustment entry against the on-account balance shown for 
 this customer. Then, in the money receipt entry, ensure the Ledger 
 Debit balance matches the value displayed during the Money Receipt 
 entry. 
 Q. What 
 step should be taken to address the problem of incorrect GST calculation ? 
 Answer: Verify 
 if the tagged HSN has a 1/3 Abatement, as this may result in the incorrect 
 calculation of the specified % of GST, (say 12%). 
 Q. What 
 action should be taken to edit a payment plan when encountering a payment 
 plan editing error ? 
 Answer: You 
 can't edit the payment plan if Plan 
 Revenue Heads exist for that payment plan. Delete Plan 
 Revenue Heads , and then you can proceed to edit the payment plan. 
 Q. How 
 should HSN tagging be handled for customization charges associated with 
 multiple HSNs ? 
 Answer: If 
 the mentioned revenue head is tagged with 3 HSNs used in transactions; 
 choose the needed HSN for the required GST % when raising an invoice. 
 Q. 
 What 
 steps should be taken to ensure that TDS entries are reflected accurately 
 in the TDS details report ? 
 Answer: Ensure 
 MR (money receipt entry) with TDS includes the challan number and 
 date for proper display in the TDS details report. Also ensure that 
 the Money Receipt is a Journal Voucher (JV) type entry. 
 Q. 
 How can the issue regarding decimals 
 while saving Credit Note Entry be addressed ? 
 Answer: When 
 creating a credit note, ensure to input - 'This reversal' amount up 
 to only 2 decimals. 
 Q. 
 How can the Financial Year visibility 
 issue be resolved to enable entries in the Application and Booking modules ? 
 Answer: Select 
 the Business unit and 
 the Financial Year will become visible for entry in Application and 
 Booking. 
 Q. 
 How can the issue of being unable to 
 change the Application Document Date be addressed ? 
 Answer: Note 
 that the Document Date cannot be changed after the entry has been 
 saved. Please ensure accuracy during the initial entry. 
 Q. 
 What action should be taken to resolve 
 the invoice error encountered for Lift Installation (CRM) ? 
 Answer: According 
 to GST requirement, you can’t create a Taxable and non-Taxable invoice 
 together. Please raise separate invoices for Taxable and non-Taxable 
 amounts . 
 Q. 
 How 
 can the payment plan amount be modified in the system ? 
 Answer: T his 
 can be modified via Booking > Booking Amendment; for existing bookings. 
 While for 
 new bookings, it is better to modify the Payment Plan Master or Plan 
 Revenue Head before going ahead with new bookings. 
 Q. 
 How 
 can I view the historical payment details of the First party in the case 
 of Buyer Transfer in the system ? 
 Answer: If 
 a buyer transfer entry is made, the system creates two separate ledgers. 
 Presently, you will get the applicant ledger print against the current 
 customer from Booking UI/Applicant Ledger UI. The system prints only 
 those transactions made against the current customer. 
 A fter making 
 the Buyer Change entry from Booking Amendment, make the balance transfer 
 entry from Payment to Customer (Document Type = Buyer Transfer). The 
 system will start showing transaction details in Applicant ledger 
 print from Booking UI/Applicant Ledger UI against the current customer. 
 If you want 
 to print the old customer ledger, you may use Sales 
 and Customer Care > Reports 
 > Applicant Ledger 
 > Applicant Ledger 
 at present. 
 Q. 
 What 
 causes the error message to appear during booking entry ? 
 Answer: Cause: 
 Multiple HSN tagged with Unit Cost. 
 Q. 
 How to resolve the inability to Change 
 Payee Name in PTC (payment to customer) ? 
 Answer: Navigate 
 to the bank details tab to change PAYEE NAME and update the information 
 accordingly. 
 Q. 
 Unit Master: Problem in Uploading Unit 
 Master Data ? 
 Answer: 
 C ause: 
 Wrong value in the sheet. 
 Solution: 
 Verify and correct the values in the excel sheet to resolve the issue 
 during the uploading of Unit Master Data. 
 Q. 
 Application 
 Booking Issue: What is the cause and solution for the problem encountered 
 while Application Booking ? 
 Answer: 
 Set up your 
 Application server Date, Time and Region & Language as follows: 
 Date Format - MM/DD/YYYY 
 Time - (UTC+05:30) Chennai, Kolkata, Mumbai, New Delhi 
 Region & Language-United States 
 Q. 
 What is the reason for the incorrect 
 balance displayed in the Rera Report ? 
 Answer: 
 Rera 
 Report is designed based on the Unit Cost Basic Amount; so the amount 
 will differ from that shown in the Booking Register Summary. 
 Q. Why 
 the refundable amount is incorrectly displayed in the Payment To Customer 
 Entry ? 
 Answer: 
 'On Account' amount will be shown in 'Payment 
 to Customer' as the refund amount. The users need to do 'On Account 
 Adjustment' with the outstanding amount to rectify this discrepancy. 
 Q. Why 
 is the Late Payment Fee amount not displayed during Receipt Adjustment 
 despite being shown in Late Payment Fee Ledger? 
 Answer: 
 C ause: 
 Interest Waiving has negative values. 
 Solution: Delete Interest Waiving and 
 recreate it. 
 Q. How 
 can I resolve the error encountered while saving a credit note ? 
 Answer: 
 Generate separate credit notes for taxable 
 and non-taxable invoices, as well as for GST reverse and GST not-reverse 
 invoices to avoid saving errors. 
 Q. How 
 to address the incorrect HSN displayed in Booking Invoice ? 
 Answer: 
 If the booking was created with a Tax Rate 
 of 12%, note that the Tax Rate cannot be changed at the time of generating 
 the Invoice. Ensure accurate tax rates are set during booking for 
 the correct representation of HSN in the invoice. 
 Q. How can 
 we ensure that cases are not saved with a blank status despite it being 
 mandatory, and how should we handle such cases to prevent automatic closure 
 after approval 
 ? 
 Answer: A ll cases with blank status are automatically 
 marked as Closed after your approval. 
 In 
 the pre-case stage, ensure you provide a status by editing it before 
 converting it to a case. 
 Q. How 
 can we address the error encountered during invoice booking for adhoc 
 charges ? 
 Answer: 
 T he error indicates 
 that the revenue head posting setup is pending for the specified revenue 
 head within the business unit. 
 Resolve this by tagging it through CRM 
 > SETUP > Account 
 Integration > Creating 
 Revenue Head Posting . 
 Q. How 
 to rectify the incorrect display of Refundable Amount during Booking Cancellation ? 
 Answer: To 
 rectify the issue, you need to create a credit note for all raised 
 invoices related to the booking. 
 Q. How 
 can we address the issue of non-approved or rejected Credit Notes not 
 being visible ? 
 Answer: Download 
 the report of unapproved or rejected credit notes from the path ADMINISTRATOR > REPORT 
 > Workflow > Document Approval History Register . 
 After obtaining the report, delete the respective entry and re-create 
 the Credit Note. 
 Q. How 
 should we handle the situation where zero GST is reflected in the ledger ? 
 Answer: 
 C ause: 
 The receipt has no tax associated with it. 
 Solution: Confirm that the receipt indeed 
 has no tax, leading to the display of 0 GST in the ledger. 
 Q. How 
 to address the HSN Error while creating Booking ? 
 Answer: 
 Ensure 
 to choose the appropriate HSN for every revenue head under the "Other 
 Charges" tab during the Booking process. 
 Q. How 
 to rectify the error in Project Hierarchy name ? 
 Answer: 
 Incorrect

title: FAQ
text:
Frequently Asked Questions 
 Frequently 
 Asked Questions 
 Q. What 
 action should be taken to resolve the error encountered while saving a 
 booking? 
 Answer: Ensure 
 the HSN of the revenue head is selected in the 'Other charges' tab. 
 Q. What steps are necessary to address the inability 
 to save a booking ? 
 Answer: Set 
 up the respective Business Unit and Revenue Head. 
 Navigate 
 to Sales and Customer Care Module > 
 Setup > Revenue 
 Head/Scheme > Revenue Template , then 
 proceed with the booking entry. 
 Q. What could be a few of the 
 causes of an issue in booking ? 
 Answer: Causes 
 of the issue: a . Pricelist effective 
 date is greater than the booking date. b. 
 Payment 
 Plan Effective Upto date is not greater than booking date. 
 Q. How can 
 the issue of inability to add co-applicant name be addressed ? 
 Answer: Navigate 
 to Booking Amendment 
 > Name Change entry 
 to Add or Remove the co-applicant. 
 Q. How to 
 make area change after Unit Closure ? 
 Answer: 
 a. 
 Initiate Booking Amendment 
 ( Area Change ) - input 
 the area and make adjustments with a negative amount in the billed 
 schedule. 
 b. Follow up with a credit note for 
 the adjusted amount. 
 Q. How to 
 address 
 the issue while changing Co-Applicant to Applicant under Booking Amendment ? 
 Answer: Ensure 
 a two-level hierarchy 
 is present. 
 Q. How can 
 the issue of being unable to save a booking amendment with parking be 
 resolved ? 
 Answer: Add 
 only an independent unit 
 (main unit) from Booking 
 Amendment ; it should not be a child unit. 
 Q. How can the issue with updating 
 customer details be resolved if the provided email IDs are already associated 
 with other customer records ? 
 Answer: If 
 provided email ids were already used in other customer records, remove 
 them from others and then try to save with the new customer details. 
 Q. How 
 can the inability to reverse an invoice through a credit note be resolved ? 
 Answer: Pass 
 a Demand Reversal credit 
 note to amend the booking. 
 Q. What 
 could be the cause of Invoice LPF (late payment fees) scheduler not working 
 and how to we resolve this issue ? 
 Answer: Cause: 
 LPF setup done after the invoice date. The system didn't recognize 
 LPF due as of the invoice date. 
 Solution: Ensure LPF setup 
 is done before or on the invoice date. 
 For e.g. Invoice 
 Number- 01IN/00504/21-22, Invoice Date is 01-08-2021. No LPF due as 
 on 01-08-2021 will be shown, since the LPF setup was done for the 
 Business Unit on 10-08-2021 therefore as per system there was no LPF 
 as on 01-08-2021. 
 Q. What steps can be taken to address 
 issues when generating an invoice ? 
 Answer: 
 Cause: 
 Account head not tagged against revenue head. 
 Solution: 
 Check account tagging against all revenue heads used in the invoice. 
 Edit and tag account head debit side/credit side as needed. 
 Q. On 
 Account Adjustment: issue: How can 
 the issue with adjusting money receipts taken as advance against revenue 
 head 'ADMINISTRATIVE CHARGES' with other revenue head bills be resolved ? 
 Answer: 
 Money Receipt taken as advance against revenue 
 head 'ADMINISTRATIVE CHARGES', cannot be adjusted with other revenue 
 head bills (e.g., CANCELLATION CHARGES, Adhoc). 
 Q. How 
 can the issue of Ledger Balance and Money Receipt Balance mismatch be 
 resolved ? 
 Answer: 
 Perform 
 on-account adjustment entry against the on-account balance shown for 
 this customer. Then, in the money receipt entry, ensure the Ledger 
 Debit balance matches the value displayed during the Money Receipt 
 entry. 
 Q. What 
 step should be taken to address the problem of incorrect GST calculation ? 
 Answer: Verify 
 if the tagged HSN has a 1/3 Abatement, as this may result in the incorrect 
 calculation of the specified % of GST, (say 12%). 
 Q. What 
 action should be taken to edit a payment plan when encountering a payment 
 plan editing error ? 
 Answer: You 
 can't edit the payment plan if Plan 
 Revenue Heads exist for that payment plan. Delete Plan 
 Revenue Heads , and then you can proceed to edit the payment plan. 
 Q. How 
 should HSN tagging be handled for customization charges associated with 
 multiple HSNs ? 
 Answer: If 
 the mentioned revenue head is tagged with 3 HSNs used in transactions; 
 choose the needed HSN for the required GST % when raising an invoice. 
 Q. 
 What 
 steps should be taken to ensure that TDS entries are reflected accurately 
 in the TDS details report ? 
 Answer: Ensure 
 MR (money receipt entry) with TDS includes the challan number and 
 date for proper display in the TDS details report. Also ensure that 
 the Money Receipt is a Journal Voucher (JV) type entry. 
 Q. 
 How can the issue regarding decimals 
 while saving Credit Note Entry be addressed ? 
 Answer: When 
 creating a credit note, ensure to input - 'This reversal' amount up 
 to only 2 decimals. 
 Q. 
 How can the Financial Year visibility 
 issue be resolved to enable entries in the Application and Booking modules ? 
 Answer: Select 
 the Business unit and 
 the Financial Year will become visible for entry in Application and 
 Booking. 
 Q. 
 How can the issue of being unable to 
 change the Application Document Date be addressed ? 
 Answer: Note 
 that the Document Date cannot be changed after the entry has been 
 saved. Please ensure accuracy during the initial entry. 
 Q. 
 What action should be taken to resolve 
 the invoice error encountered for Lift Installation (CRM) ? 
 Answer: According 
 to GST requirement, you can’t create a Taxable and non-Taxable invoice 
 together. Please raise separate invoices for Taxable and non-Taxable 
 amounts . 
 Q. 
 How 
 can the payment plan amount be modified in the system ? 
 Answer: T his 
 can be modified via Booking > Booking Amendment; for existing bookings. 
 While for 
 new bookings, it is better to modify the Payment Plan Master or Plan 
 Revenue Head before going ahead with new bookings. 
 Q. 
 How 
 can I view the historical payment details of the First party in the case 
 of Buyer Transfer in the system ? 
 Answer: If 
 a buyer transfer entry is made, the system creates two separate ledgers. 
 Presently, you will get the applicant ledger print against the current 
 customer from Booking UI/Applicant Ledger UI. The system prints only 
 those transactions made against the current customer. 
 A fter making 
 the Buyer Change entry from Booking Amendment, make the balance transfer 
 entry from Payment to Customer (Document Type = Buyer Transfer). The 
 system will start showing transaction details in Applicant ledger 
 print from Booking UI/Applicant Ledger UI against the current customer. 
 If you want 
 to print the old customer ledger, you may use Sales 
 and Customer Care > Reports 
 > Applicant Ledger 
 > Applicant Ledger 
 at present. 
 Q. 
 What 
 causes the error message to appear during booking entry ? 
 Answer: Cause: 
 Multiple HSN tagged with Unit Cost. 
 Q. 
 How to resolve the inability to Change 
 Payee Name in PTC (payment to customer) ? 
 Answer: Navigate 
 to the bank details tab to change PAYEE NAME and update the information 
 accordingly. 
 Q. 
 Unit Master: Problem in Uploading Unit 
 Master Data ? 
 Answer: 
 C ause: 
 Wrong value in the sheet. 
 Solution: 
 Verify and correct the values in the excel sheet to resolve the issue 
 during the uploading of Unit Master Data. 
 Q. 
 Application 
 Booking Issue: What is the cause and solution for the problem encountered 
 while Application Booking ? 
 Answer: 
 Set up your 
 Application server Date, Time and Region & Language as follows: 
 Date Format - MM/DD/YYYY 
 Time - (UTC+05:30) Chennai, Kolkata, Mumbai, New Delhi 
 Region & Language-United States 
 Q. 
 What is the reason for the incorrect 
 balance displayed in the Rera Report ? 
 Answer: 
 Rera 
 Report is designed based on the Unit Cost Basic Amount; so the amount 
 will differ from that shown in the Booking Register Summary. 
 Q. Why 
 the refundable amount is incorrectly displayed in the Payment To Customer 
 Entry ? 
 Answer: 
 'On Account' amount will be shown in 'Payment 
 to Customer' as the refund amount. The users need to do 'On Account 
 Adjustment' with the outstanding amount to rectify this discrepancy. 
 Q. Why 
 is the Late Payment Fee amount not displayed during Receipt Adjustment 
 despite being shown in Late Payment Fee Ledger? 
 Answer: 
 C ause: 
 Interest Waiving has negative values. 
 Solution: Delete Interest Waiving and 
 recreate it. 
 Q. How 
 can I resolve the error encountered while saving a credit note ? 
 Answer: 
 Generate separate credit notes for taxable 
 and non-taxable invoices, as well as for GST reverse and GST not-reverse 
 invoices to avoid saving errors. 
 Q. How 
 to address the incorrect HSN displayed in Booking Invoice ? 
 Answer: 
 If the booking was created with a Tax Rate 
 of 12%, note that the Tax Rate cannot be changed at the time of generating 
 the Invoice. Ensure accurate tax rates are set during booking for 
 the correct representation of HSN in the invoice. 
 Q. How can 
 we ensure that cases are not saved with a blank status despite it being 
 mandatory, and how should we handle such cases to prevent automatic closure 
 after approval 
 ? 
 Answer: A ll cases with blank status are automatically 
 marked as Closed after your approval. 
 In 
 the pre-case stage, ensure you provide a status by editing it before 
 converting it to a case.

 can we address the error encountered during invoice booking for adhoc 
 charges ? 
 Answer: 
 T he error indicates 
 that the revenue head posting setup is pending for the specified revenue 
 head within the business unit. 
 Resolve this by tagging it through CRM 
 > SETUP > Account 
 Integration > Creating 
 Revenue Head Posting . 
 Q. How

 Answer: To 
 rectify the issue, you need to create a credit note for all raised 
 invoices related to the booking. 
 Q. How 
 can we address the issue of non-approved or rejected Credit Notes not 
 being visible ? 
 Answer: Download 
 the report of unapproved or rejected credit notes from the path ADMINISTRATOR > REPORT 
 > Workflow > Document Approval History Register . 
 After obtaining the report, delete the respective entry and re-create 
 the Credit Note.

 should we handle the situation where zero GST is reflected in the ledger ? 
 Answer: 
 C ause: 
 The receipt has no tax associated with it. 
 Solution: Confirm that the receipt indeed 
 has no tax, leading to the display of 0 GST in the ledger.

 Ensure 
 to choose the appropriate HSN for every revenue head under the "Other 
 Charges" tab during the Booking process.
